reason: Steel could provide a frame for the cabin mattress in the sheltered alcove.
expectation: The steel and mattress will make a supported berth.

effect: Steel does not combine with the mattress, but its listed partner is reflective insulation.
reaction: The suggested pairing is less obvious than a bed frame, so I am curious what it makes.
reason: The failed attempt identifies reflective insulation as a compatible partner for steel.
expectation: The combination will make a component for the sheltered berth.

effect: The steel and insulation made a raised, insulated frame ready for the mattress.
reaction: The insulation beneath the deck makes the pairing clearer.
reason: The mattress should fit on the prepared berth frame.
expectation: The mattress will complete the sheltered berth.

effect: The mattress completed the cave berth and the chapter’s goal.
reaction: The boots-under-the-bed detail made the finished berth feel lived in.

mostWorthwhile.text: Completing the berth was most worthwhile: the final scene made the practical construction feel like a personal refuge.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to put the mattress directly on steel was the least worthwhile moment, though it revealed a useful partner.

surprise.text: Steel combined with insulation first, making a raised frame with insulation beneath the deck; the physical purpose became clear in the result.

arbitrary.text: The required order initially felt somewhat arbitrary because a steel frame for the mattress seemed plausible, but the resulting insulated frame explained the pairing.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical construction and the glimpse of the still-empty growing room make me curious about what comes next, although this chapter was brief.
